summary: Samurai civ with Bannermen that boost nearby units and Town Centers that can be upgraded. Strong infantry and a good late game.

spikes.label: Bannermen and Onna-Bugeisha
spikes.detail: Bannermen boost nearby units, and Onna-Bugeisha are cheap anti-cavalry infantry.

spikes.label: Monks or priests
spikes.detail: Their Castle landmark picks Buddhist Monks or Shinto Priests.
spikes.answer: Scout which one and plan around it.

spikes.label: Ozutsu and Atakebune
spikes.detail: Imperial gunpowder siege and a heavy warship on water maps.
spikes.answer: Take fights before Imperial if you can.

winConditions.detail: Strong infantry pushes boosted by Bannermen.
Upgraded farm Town Centers late game.
